title: Speech Contrast Lab — Track C functional demo
description:
A local prototype for Track C of the Multimodal AI Hackathon 2026. It compares two recordings of the same text, explains local acoustic differences and replays the interval behind each alert.

Code, 34 paired recordings and the six-page technical report:
https://github.com/HyunsikParker/speech-contrast-lab

This edited walkthrough uses actual interface captures and public-domain White House weekly-address excerpts. Playback sequences were captured at 1–2 frames per second. Tempo, pause, volume and noise edits keep the original words; they are test perturbations, not the speakers' original deliveries. No voice was cloned or synthesized.

The recorded v2 gate failed: 16/18 moderate or strong targets were localized, 0/10 subtle targets were localized, and 1/6 controls raised a false alert. All results remain visible. Reference similarity is not persuasiveness, speaking ability or an official contest score.

OpenAI Codex assisted with implementation, tests, documentation and demo assembly. Whisper and wav2vec2 run locally as frozen pretrained models; no paid API or training is used.
